pages.title: TFMG Oil and Fuels
pages.text: TFMG's oil chain: find crude oil, pump it up, split it in a distillation tower, then burn the fractions or cook them into plastic and rubber.

pages.title: Surface Scanner
pages.text: Powered from below, its 5x5 grid shows nearby chunks. Chunks holding an oil deposit glow.

pages.title: Pumpjack
pages.text: Run Industrial Pipe from the deposit to the surface, set the base on top, then hammer parts (glued together) and a crank driven through a Machine Input.

pages.title: Distillation Tower
pages.text: Steel tanks, a controller beside them, and up to 6 outputs separated by Industrial Pipes. Heat under the tanks; oil goes into the controller.
Crude oil splits into heavy oil, diesel, kerosene, naphtha, gasoline and LPG. Heavy oil distills again into more diesel and kerosene plus lubrication oil. A Flarestack burns whatever you do not need.

pages.title: Fuels into rotation
pages.text: Large Engines burn diesel, kerosene, naphtha or furnace gas for rotation. See [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG Engines](entry://industry/tfmg_engines)[#]().

pages.title: Firebox
pages.text: Heats machines above it like a Blaze Burner, burning LPG, butane, propane, diesel, naphtha or kerosene. CO2 must be pumped out. See [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().
Plastic: naphtha in a heated vat splits into ethylene and propylene. Either becomes molten plastic, which a Casting Basin turns into Plastic Sheets. Heavy oil plus sulfur makes rubber.

Fuels also burn in Blaze Burners: piped diesel, gasoline, kerosene, naphtha and heavy oil heat one, and napalm superheats it. The Straw burner also takes crude oil and creosote. See [#](2E5AAC)[Burning Liquid Fuel](entry://industry/liquid_fuel)[#](). Pipes and pumps: [#](2E5AAC)[Fluids](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#]().
